Phir wahaaṅ jaaye ziyaarat ko sabhi ahl-e-aza
Ya Fatema salaamullaah alaiha...\"\"\"
# Preserve the source's written consonants in ہنس and آنچل.

Audited all 45 Roman verse lines against the Urdu in [ya-fatema.md](/home/ghayur/.local/state/kalam-codex-round2/shards/3/workspaces/7e0f2f44d130492ca05e411f5da1d726/src/data/lyrics/ya-fatema.md).
